events.summary: The IAEA Board of Governors reported Iran's safeguards non-compliance to the UN Security Council and General Assembly. This referral is not itself a Security Council sanction or enforcement action.

Houthi forces seized Mocha and advanced onto or took positions on the Hanish islands. Sourced reporting linked Iranian arms/advice to the offensive, while direct Iranian operational command remained disputed.

Houthi forces took Dhubab and government forces withdrew from Perim/Mayun amid a continued Red Sea coastal advance. Geographic possession strengthens the Houthi position around Bab el-Mandeb but does not establish unqualified control of all strait traffic.

OFAC designated Iran-linked proxy support networks, announced an Iran-related enforcement action and shifted Iran-related specific-license review to a presumption of denial subject to stated exceptions. This records enacted September 10 action, not any separately announced future sanction.

Iran temporarily suspended its 10% freight-fee charge on foreign vessels transporting specified energy products to or from Iran pending approval/publication of a definitive taxable-products list. Implementation and commercial recovery effects remain unresolved.

Kpler data reported seven observable vessel transits through Hormuz on Sep. 10, versus 11 the prior day and a 10-day average of 15. The metric is AIS/observable-provider traffic and excludes unknown dark traffic.

Baltic Exchange data reported Gulf of Oman-to-China VLCC freight around Worldscale 450, roughly $11.50 per barrel, a record for the wartime route series; West Africa-to-Asia VLCC rates also reached records.

South Korea's and Iran's foreign ministers discussed Hormuz and navigation security at Iran's request while Seoul continued assessing contribution options. No South Korean troop or naval deployment decision was established.

President Masoud Pezeshkian publicly acknowledged material sanctions/war effects and reported roughly a 35% fall in foreign trade. The percentage is an Iranian presidential self-assessment, not an independently audited trade statistic.
